//: Config of scripts/docs_sync.py. Paths are relative to the repository root; keys named // are comments. Edit the three values marked EDIT; everything else works as it is.
//aliases: Optional short forms you use in the map, e.g. {"S/": "src/myapp/"}; glob tokens in the map may use them.

map.//: EDIT 1: the files the code map must name (by file name, stem or a backticked glob like `user_*.py`).
map.//search_roots: Where names written in the map are looked up (a name that exists nowhere gives a warning).

//lists: Optional: items taken from a source file by a regex, e.g. the values of an enum. Rendered by a 'list' block, compared by 'counts'. Example: {"themes": {"file": "src/theme.py", "pattern": "^    ([A-Z_]+) = ", "item": "`{0}`"}}

inventory.title: All mapped source files by folder

//counts: Optional: numbers in a doc that must equal a list's length, e.g. {"file": "docs/FEATURES.md", "pattern": "(\\d+) themes", "list": "themes"}
//commands: Optional external checks, e.g. {"name": "lint", "run": ["npm", "run", "lint"], "hint": "fix the lint errors"}

warn_if_changed.//: EDIT 3: the code that ships to users (its changes need release notes).
warn_if_changed.message: code changed but release-notes/next.md is empty: write the user-facing notes of this push
